english.labiia.credits.theTwelveLexicalAnalysesT: the thirteen lexical analyses, their settings and figures, by Rafael Cardoso Sampaio (UFPE, labiia_lab)
english.labiia.credits.reinertMethodChdScriptsLe: Reinert method (CHD) scripts, lemmatisation dictionaries (pt, en, es) and compound expressions, by Pierre Ratinaud
english.labiia.credits.portuguesePolarityLexicon: Portuguese polarity lexicon used by Sentiment, by Marlo Souza and Renata Vieira (PUCRS)
english.labiia.credits.emotionLexiconUsedByEmoti: emotion lexicon used by Emotions (through syuzhet), by Saif M. Mohammad and Peter D. Turney
english.labiia.credits.freeForResearchAndTeachin: Free for research and teaching; commercial use of this lexicon needs a licence from the National Research Council Canada.
english.labiia.credits.keywordExtractionMethodAn: keyword extraction method and its stopwords, by Campos, Mangaravite, Pasquali, Jorge, Nunes and Jatowt (LIAAD / INESC TEC)
english.labiia.credits.intertopicDistanceMapAndT: intertopic distance map and term relevance, by Carson Sievert and Kenneth Shirley (method)
english.labiia.credits.thematicMapAxesAndTheme: Thematic map axes and theme labels, by Massimo Aria and Corrado Cuccurullo (method)
english.labiia.credits.connectedConceptsWordTree: connected concepts, word tree and n-gram ideas brought in by labiia_lex (methods)
english.labiia.credits.statisticalComputingEnvir: statistical computing environment, by the R Core Team
english.labiia.credits.wordCloudsOfTheChd: word clouds of the CHD classes and similitude
english.labiia.credits.ldaTopicModelsByBettina: LDA topic models, by Bettina Grün and Kurt Hornik
english.labiia.credits.emotionsWithTheNrcLexicon: emotions with the NRC lexicon, by Matthew Jockers
english.labiia.credits.exchangingDataBetweenRAnd: exchanging data between R and the program
english.labiia.credits.lexicalTitle: Lexical analyses: origin, resources and methods
english.labiia.credits.lexicalIntro: The lexical analyses come from labiia_lex and, through it, from IRaMuTeQ. The dictionaries and lexicons below ship with the program; the methods are reimplemented from their publications.
english.labiia.credits.rIntro: Word cloud, CHD, Similitude, Emotions and LDA run in R with these CRAN packages. They are not bundled: the installer or the program downloads them from CRAN, each under its own licence.
english.labiia.credits.forceAtlas2Role: the text network layout, ForceAtlas2 (Jacomy, Venturini, Heymann & Bastian, 2014), with the settings labiia_lex uses in Gephi
english.labiia.credits.louvainRole: the communities of the text network (Blondel et al., 2008), ported with the same steps and random order
english.labiia.credits.sigmaRole: drawing and interaction of the text network (sigma.js, graphology, ForceAtlas2 layout)
english.labiia.credits.openRefineRole: the methods that group spelling variants in "Prepare corpus" (fingerprint, character n-grams, edit distance), reimplemented from its documentation as labiia_lex does; no code copied
english.labiia.credits.rIntroMac: Word cloud, CHD, Similitude, Emotions and LDA run in R with these CRAN packages. They are not bundled: the program downloads them from CRAN, each under its own licence.

english.labiia.diagnostics.title: Program diagnostics
english.labiia.diagnostics.startHint: Check every part works and copy a report
english.labiia.diagnostics.intro: This window checks each part of labiia_quali on this computer. When something is marked ✗, follow the advice, or copy the report and send it to whoever supports you. The report holds versions, folder paths and error messages, but no text from your projects.
english.labiia.diagnostics.dataFolderNotWritable: The program cannot write to this folder, so preferences and the analyses' cache are not kept. Check the folder's permissions, or free some disk space.
english.labiia.diagnostics.nodeMissing: The component that runs the lexical analyses is missing from the installation.
english.labiia.diagnostics.helperFilesMissing: Files the lexical analyses need are missing from the installation.
english.labiia.diagnostics.reinstall: The installation is incomplete. Install labiia_quali again; if the problem stays, send the report.
english.labiia.diagnostics.helperBlockedMac: macOS stopped the component from running. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll to the end and click "Open Anyway" if labiia_quali or labiia-node is listed. Otherwise, delete labiia_quali from Applications and install it again from the .dmg.
english.labiia.diagnostics.helperBlockedWindows: Windows or the antivirus stopped the component from running. Allow labiia_quali in the antivirus and open the program again.
english.labiia.diagnostics.tempFolderNotWritable: The analyses cannot write their temporary files here. Free some disk space and try again.
english.labiia.diagnostics.rNotChecked: Not checked: the lexical analyses component did not start.
english.labiia.diagnostics.packagesAdvice: Install them from Preferences → R (Install missing packages). Only the analyses that use them need them.
english.labiia.diagnostics.rNotFound: R was not found ({{places}} places checked; the list is in the report).
english.labiia.diagnostics.rAdviceMac: Install R for Mac from its official site (Download R for Mac, in a lexical analysis' R panel), choosing the installer for Apple silicon (arm64), then click Look again. Word frequencies and other analyses without R work meanwhile.
english.labiia.diagnostics.rAdviceWindows: Install R (the labiia_quali installer offers to) or choose where it is in Preferences → R. Analyses without R work meanwhile.
english.labiia.diagnostics.libreOfficeMissing: Not found. Only needed to import codebooks saved in the old Word format (.doc).
english.labiia.diagnostics.lastCrashAdvice: The cause is in the report. Send it, so the problem can be fixed.
english.labiia.diagnostics.nodeLookedIn: Where the component was looked for:
english.labiia.diagnostics.copied: Report copied. Paste it into an email or message.
english.labiia.diagnostics.copyFailed: The report could not be copied. Use Save report… instead.
english.labiia.diagnostics.startupProblem: A part of the program could not be started
english.labiia.diagnostics.startupProblemText: The lexical analyses will not work until this is solved. The diagnostics say what happened.
english.labiia.diagnostics.startupCrash: The program closed unexpectedly last time
english.labiia.diagnostics.startupCrashText: The cause was recorded. Sending the report helps fix it.
english.labiia.diagnostics.helperDidNotStart: The component that runs the lexical analyses did not start, so R could not be looked for. See the diagnostics. ({{error}})
english.labiia.diagnostics.helperFailedRun: The component that runs the lexical analyses did not start or stopped. See the diagnostics. ({{error}})
